test('performers never swap lanes in later solos, reversed duets, or equal-start phrases', () => {
  const lines = [line('a1','A',0,3), line('b1','B',1,4), line('bSolo','B',6,7),
    line('b2','B',10,15), line('a2','A',11,14), line('a3','A',11,14)];
  const layout = vocalLayout(lines);
  for (const l of lines) assert.equal(layout.get(l.id)?.side, l.agent === 'A' ? 'left' : 'right');
  const last = vocalScenes(lines).at(-1)!;
  const cells = vocalSceneRows(last.groups, layout);
  assert.deepEqual([...cells.values()].map(c => c.row), [1,2,3]);
  assert.ok([...cells.values()].every(c => c.rowSpan === 1));
});
test('a score without performers stays single-column and annotations remain grouped', () => {
  const lines = [line('a','',0,2),line('b','',1,4)];
  assert.ok([...vocalLayout(lines).values()].every(l => !l.split && l.side === 'left'));
});
